# ANALYSIS: vix_regime_stratification_bearish_rejection_ride_the_ribbon

**Filed:** 2026-09-11
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We aim to stratify the historical performance of the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON strategy by VIX regime (VIX<15, 15-20, >20) to determine whether the current VIX confirmation rule (VIX rising OR already above 20) adds predictive value or is redundant. If the rule is predictive, we expect to see significantly better performance in the VIX>20 regime (and/or when VIX is rising) and poor performance in low VIX regimes. If redundant, the strategy's edge would be evenly distributed across VIX regimes or the VIX rule would not improve risk-adjusted returns.

## Mechanism

No mechanism change is proposed in this analysis. We will use the existing BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON strategy (as defined in the playbook) and, for each trade taken, record the VIX level at the time of entry (not the trend) to bucket into one of three regimes: VIX < 15, 15 ≤ VIX ≤ 20, VIX > 20. We will then compute the P&L, win rate, and other metrics per regime. Additionally, we will compare the performance of the current strategy (with VIX rule) to a hypothetical strategy that removes the VIX rule (i.e., takes all signals that pass the other filters) to see if the VIX rule improves the strategy's edge.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per playbook position sizing table).
2. **Sample bias:** The analysis will use the same historical data as the base strategy Stage-1 run (which used BS-synthetic option pricing over historical SPY/VIX bars). The sample size and selection method are unknown without running the stratified backtest, but we note that the base strategy Stage-1 run processed 225 trades (wide_n_trades=225) over the period 2025-Q1 to 2026-Q2. Overfit risk is high if we stratify without sufficient samples per regime.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (we plan to run a walk-forward held-out window after obtaining the stratified IS results).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (we will need to validate the stratified results with real OPRA fills on the top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (we cannot enumerate failure modes per VIX regime without the stratified performance breakdown).
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (we cannot compute the percentage of P&L from the top 5 days without the stratified daily P&L breakdown).
